methods.notes: InfiniTime advertises on startup. Disconnect another companion if the watch is occupied, then confirm firmware 1.16.0 and the actual service set instead of assuming every optional surface is enabled.

identification.notes: The firmware device name is InfiniTime. Match the name only as a candidate, then read 00002a26-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb and require exactly 1.16.0 before writes. Other PineTime firmware is not supported by this spec.

device.name: Pine64 PineTime (InfiniTime 1.16.0)
device.notes:
Scope is exactly InfiniTime 1.16.0 on PineTime. Read Firmware Revision and stop before writes on any other version. The older 00040000 weather service is not a fallback: Simple Weather 00050000 replaced it in 1.14 and is the only weather layout in this spec.
BLE roles are bidirectional. The phone connects as GATT client to watch-hosted battery/HR/DFU/music/navigation/call/motion/weather/FS and to watch-hosted CTS/ANS. Independently, the watch is a GATT CLIENT that discovers CTS and ANS hosted by the COMPANION: it reads phone Current Time and subscribes to phone New Alert. A client that only enumerates watch services misses that reverse path. Both directions are declared separately in protocol_details.ble_roles; do not assume one service UUID implies one direction throughout a session.

openness.notes: Open firmware and public protocol documentation are the authority here. Source commit CMakeLists declares version 1.16.0; this is not a family-wide claim about other PineTime firmware or future MOY_* targets.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: The firmware advertises on startup and Gadgetbridge marks PineTime pair-free.

exclusivity.recovery: Disconnect Gadgetbridge, InfiniLink, itd, Siglo or another central before switching clients; no reset or account unbind is needed.

pairing.notes: Pair-free means no pairing/bond is required, not that a user cannot choose a host-specific security configuration. No application-layer credential follows.

unpair.notes: No bond is created for the covered path; disconnect and optionally forget an OS convenience entry.

credentials.notes: No Pine64 account, Wi-Fi passphrase, cloud token or application encryption key is used. BLE FS contents and health-adjacent readings need owner-controlled handling even though no credentials protect them.
stored_on_device: Watch settings and BLE FS files
Optional host Bluetooth state (no bond required)

factory_reset.description: The quick-start and pinned settings/OTA documentation establish firmware validation and recovery, not a general erase/settings reset. A reboot, firmware rollback, or validate action is not a factory reset. No reset bytes or button hold are invented here.
factory_reset.effect: No owner-level full factory reset or exact clearing scope was established for InfiniTime 1.16.0.

methods.description: Scan for InfiniTime, read firmware 1.16.0, subscribe to watch notifications, and optionally host CTS/ANS on the companion so the watch can discover them. Enable DFU/file access only for a deliberate operation.

steps.action: Disconnect the old companion and scan for the exact name InfiniTime.

steps.expect: UTF-8 string exactly 1.16.0; otherwise stop before writes.

steps.action: Subscribe to battery, heart rate, motion, music-event and call-event notifications as needed, and to BLE FS transfer before file commands.
For reverse time/alert sync, host CTS 1805 and ANS 1811 on the companion and let the watch discover/read Current Time and subscribe to New Alert.
steps.expect: The watch obtains time from the companion and receives phone-hosted alerts; this is separate from writes to watch-hosted CTS/ANS.

steps.action: Leave firmware update and mutating BLE FS operations disabled unless explicitly enabled and intended.

causes: The companion implemented only a GATT client. The watch also acts as a client and must find CTS/ANS hosted on the companion.
troubleshooting.symptom: Time or alerts never arrive although watch GATT writes work.

causes: This spec covers only 1.16.0 Simple Weather. Do not write the legacy 00040000 layout or assume a future message version.
troubleshooting.symptom: Weather is ignored on an older/newer firmware.

causes: Firmware & files access is disabled in settings. Enable it deliberately, preferably only until reboot.
Gadgetbridge reports steps are advertised mainly while the screen is on; this is not a reliable historical activity database.

setup.notes: No provisioning, account or bond is needed for the documented local surfaces. Medium confidence follows public firmware and working open companions; no flow was replayed by this project. DFU and BLE FS can be disabled in watch settings and require an explicit advanced opt-in.

rejoin.notes: Disconnect the previous companion and connect the new one. There is no vendor account binding; repeat the firmware-version and service-role checks.

steps.action: Disconnect the old companion and scan for InfiniTime.
Read firmware 1.16.0 and rediscover both watch-hosted and companion-hosted roles.
steps.expect: The new client has the expected notifications and, if used, its own CTS/ANS server is discovered.

testing.notes: No PineTime was connected or updated from this document. Every protocol fact is reported from the pinned open firmware/documentation, not independently confirmed on hardware. Test vectors use invented weather/file values only.

variants.notes: The sole supported target, identified after connection by Firmware Revision. Sealed and developer-kit PineTime share this protocol only when running that exact firmware; non-InfiniTime and other versions are excluded.

entities.name: Heart Rate
entities.notes: Valid for current flags=0 frames; extended SIG formats require a full parser.

entities.name: Steps
entities.notes: Current advertised count, mainly while screen is on; not reliable end-of-day history or sleep tracking.

evidence.companion_documentation: Gadgetbridge's model page supplies pair-free support and the limitation that steps are advertised mainly with the screen on, without a sleep/history claim.
evidence.firmware_source: InfiniTime at 9ad16304f5fd526b781a760cf1313813d232645e declares 1.16.0. Its BLE implementations establish both client/server CTS/ANS roles, exact GATT properties, Simple Weather lengths/endian/sentinels, BLE FS packed layouts/statuses and the legacy DFU state machine. Public docs are used beside, not instead of, those facts.
evidence.negative_findings: No hardware capture, clinical validation, firmware binary or general factory-reset procedure was found. Legacy weather is incompatible. BLE FS uses signed LittleFS statuses, not upstream Adafruit unsigned statuses. File/DFU authorization can be disabled and was not bypassed.
evidence.official_device_documentation: Pine64's wiki identifies PineTime/nRF52832 and InfiniTime as default OS and lists independent companions. The quick-start/FCC artifacts identify the product; no proprietary factory firmware behavior is inferred.
evidence.open_questions: A 1.16.0 GATT/companion-service dump is still needed for live role behavior, HR extended formats, motion cadence, weather long writes and a small FS read/list. Reset scope, maximum centrals and interrupted DFU recovery also remain unverified.

dfu_mode.notes: No separate DfuTarg identity or address offset is established for this in-place update path.

enter.notes: The running application accepts 01 04 after advanced opt-in; no separate bootloader-entry command is claimed.

image.format: nrfutil DFU zip containing application .bin and matching .dat init packet
image.notes: Use only officially produced images matching PineTime/InfiniTime 1.16. The .dat carries expected CRC; do not synthesize it.

dfu.notes: Nine documented steps, 20-byte data segments, receipt counts and CRC validation. No generic/partial updater is exposed; a dedicated implementation owns the whole flow. Never mix with MCUBoot recovery or an arbitrary image.

recovery.notes: After successful activation, validate firmware in watch settings or the previous image may be restored. Interrupted-transfer behavior needs a recoverable-unit test.

ans.empty_rule: Firmware ignores a packet of three bytes or fewer; at least one text byte is needed after the separator.

simple.decoded: one simple alert, title Test Title, body Test Body

ans.value: category:u8 | count:u8 | 00 | NUL-separated UTF-8 text fields

delete.advanced_reason: Deletes owner files/directories; no recycle operation is documented.

list_directory.response: 51 | status:i8 | path_length:u16 | entry:u32 | total_entries:u32 | flags:u32 | modification_time_ns:u64 | file_size:u32 | relative_path
list_directory.termination: Responses continue until entry == total_entries; final has empty path. Flags bit 0 marks a directory.

mkdir.advanced_reason: Changes watch filesystem layout; enable only for a selected destination.

move.advanced_reason: Renames/moves owner files or directories and can break installed resources.
move.request: 60 | pad:1 | old_path_length:u16 | new_path_length:u16 | old_path | pad:1 | new_path

read_begin.response: 11 | status:i8 | pad:2 | chunk_offset:u32 | total_length:u32 | chunk_length:u32 | data

read_continue.response: Same 11 response; repeat until requested bytes are complete. No close command.

write_begin.advanced_reason: Creates/overwrites owner files and can consume all watch storage.
write_begin.request: 20 | pad:1 | path_length:u16 | offset:u32 | modification_time_ns:u64 | total_size:u32 | path

write_continue.advanced_reason: Writes file bytes; offset/length mismatch can corrupt the intended file.
write_continue.response: Same 21 response; stop when reported free space is zero. No close command.

ble_fs.paths: Absolute UTF-8 paths begin /. No NUL terminator is sent. Cap at 255 bytes plus local terminator for memory safety; firmware's 256-byte array/length handling must not be relied on.
ble_fs.response_matching: Read response is 11 for both 10/12 requests; write response 21 for both 20/22; delete 31, mkdir 41, list 51, move 61. Match status before variable data and bounds-check every declared length.
ble_fs.status: Signed int8. 0x01 is success; negative values are LittleFS errors, NOT Adafruit unsigned status codes. Never print a negative status as 0..255 without sign conversion.

list_final_response.decoded: entry 2 == total 2, empty path terminates listing

read_response.decoded: success, offset 0, total 9, chunk boot; remaining 5 bytes require read_continue

companion_ans.direction: Companion is GATT server; PineTime is GATT client.
companion_ans.operation: Watch discovers New Alert and subscribes through its CCCD. Companion emits alert values; watch consumes them.

companion_cts.direction: Companion is GATT server; PineTime is GATT client.
companion_cts.operation: Watch discovers service and reads the 10-byte Current Time value.
companion_cts.value_layout: year u16 LE; month/day/hour/minute/second u8; weekday u8; fractions256 u8; adjust reason u8.

ble_roles.role_test_requirement: Tests must assert all four roles independently, not merely assert UUID presence in the watch service table.

watch_ans.direction: PineTime is GATT server; companion is GATT client.
watch_ans.operation: Companion writes New Alert directly; watch emits custom call-event notifications on 00020001-78fc-48fe-8e23-433b3a1942d0.

watch_cts.direction: PineTime is GATT server; companion is GATT client.
watch_cts.operation: Companion may read/write watch Current Time and Local Time Information; this does not replace companion-hosted discovery.

activate_image_and_reset.prerequisite: Require 10 04 01; never activate after CRC failure.

init_packet_complete.description: Write the matching .dat packet FIRST, then send 02 01, and only after sending it wait for 10 02 01.

dfu.crc: The pinned source validates CRC-16 with polynomial 0x1021, initial 0xffff, over the complete application image; the matching .dat supplies the expected value.

packet_writes.application_image_size: Eight zero bytes for SoftDevice/bootloader sizes, then application size as u32 LE.
packet_writes.dfu_init_packet: The exact .dat bytes supplied with the selected official image; never synthesize them.
packet_writes.firmware_segment: At most 20 bytes per segment; every receipt count must equal the actual number of bytes sent.

dfu.required_handler: One dedicated implementation must own control-point subscription, sequencing, image bytes, notifications, receipts, CRC failure and recovery before any write is attempted; no generic or partial updater is exposed.
dfu.safety: Advanced and optional at every step. No hardware verification, alternate bootloader flow, or non-official image is claimed.
sequence: Packet: SoftDevice u32 LE=0, bootloader u32 LE=0, application size u32 LE.
Control 08 0a for receipts each ten segments; control 03.
Packet image in <=20-byte segments. Receipt 11 + received_bytes:u32 LE must equal bytes sent.
Wait 10 03 01; control 04; require 10 04 01 (a CRC failure is terminal).
Control 05 to activate/reboot; then validate in watch settings or previous image may boot.

firmware_scope.unsupported_action: Stop before any write; do not fall back to legacy weather or another version's layout.

music.metadata_encoding: UTF-8; 40-byte display cap with ellipsis in firmware.

navigation.full_list_source: InfiniTime 1.16 doc/NavigationService.md; turn-stright is an upstream spelling in that list.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.notes: Local-time UNIX seconds in the timezone used to set watch time.

fields.name: location
fields.notes: UTF-8 bytes, zero padded; firmware adds its own terminator. No NUL required in the 32-byte field.

fields.name: sunrise
fields.notes: Minutes since midnight; 0 sun already up, -1 unknown, -2 no sunrise.

fields.name: sunset
fields.notes: Minutes since midnight; -1 unknown, -2 no sunset.

current.sun_validation: Version 1 accepts each in -2..1439. If either is -1, values are out of range, sunrise is -2 without sunset -2, or nonnegative sunrise >= sunset, firmware treats both as unknown.

fields.name: number_of_days
fields.notes: Firmware clamps larger values to five; a strict client should reject them instead.

fields.name: five_day_slots
fields.notes: Five records of min:int16 LE (0.01 C), max:int16 LE (0.01 C), icon:u8. Zero-fill unused slots.

simple_weather.malformed_rule: Reject unknown type/version and any message shorter than its fixed layout before reading fields. Do not substitute the legacy 00040000 weather layout.

current_v1.expected: -3.50 C current, -7.00 C min, 2.00 C max, snow, location Oslo; 53 bytes

forecast_v0.expected: One snow day; remaining four slots all zero; 36 bytes

remaining_unknowns: Live 1.16.0 companion-service discovery and notification behavior on each host stack.
Heart-rate extended SIG formats and sensor cadence; current two-byte example is not a universal parser.
Historical activity/sleep behavior; only current motion values are documented and step advertisements can be missed while screen is off.
Maximum simultaneous centrals and any owner-level full factory reset/clearing scope.
BLE FS behavior at long paths/large transfers, exact host long-write requirements, and all negative LittleFS conditions.
Interrupted DFU recovery and exact image/signature policy; never test first on an unrecoverable unit.

characteristics.name: Firmware Revision
characteristics.notes: UTF-8 version string. This spec proceeds only for exactly 1.16.0.

format.name: flags
format.notes: SIG flags: bit 0 selects uint8 versus uint16 heart rate and other bits select optional fields.

format.name: heart_rate
format.notes: Valid only when flags bit 0 is 0. Do not hard-code a two-byte parser when extended fields are present.

format_match.notes: Current firmware emits flags 0 and one uint8 BPM. Any other flags require the full SIG parser.

set_current_time.description: Write the standard ten-byte current-time value to watch-hosted CTS; separate from the watch reading companion-hosted CTS.

adjust_reason.description: SIG adjust-reason bit field; ignored by the 1.16 writer.

fractions256.description: Fractions of a second in 1/256-second units; ignored by the 1.16 writer.

weekday.description: SIG weekday code; 0 is unknown/not used by the 1.16 writer.

characteristics.name: Current Time
characteristics.notes: Ten bytes: year u16 LE, month/day/hour/minute/second, weekday, fractions256, adjust reason. The 1.16 source ignores fractions/reason when writing.

characteristics.name: Local Time Information
characteristics.notes: Two signed bytes: timezone and DST offset, using the SIG Local Time Information encoding. Read before writing; no custom fixed timezone constant is supplied.

services.name: Current Time Service (watch-hosted)
services.notes: Watch-hosted CTS, distinct from the companion-hosted CTS the watch discovers as a client. Current Time is read/write here; the companion-hosted direction is in protocol_details.ble_roles.companion_cts.

characteristics.name: New Alert
characteristics.notes: Category, count, 00 separator, then NUL-separated UTF-8 fields. See protocol_details.ans for category table and exact examples; not a fixed-length characteristic.

services.name: Alert Notification Service (watch-hosted)
services.notes: Watch-hosted ANS accepts direct New Alert writes and carries the custom call event. Independently, the watch discovers and subscribes to a companion-hosted ANS; see protocol_details.ble_roles.companion_ans.

characteristics.name: DFU Control Point
characteristics.notes: Control-point writes and notifications are deliberately not exposed as generic commands. protocol_details.dfu documents the required sequence.

characteristics.name: DFU Packet
characteristics.notes: Image/init bytes require a dedicated implementation. No bare framing or byte-parameter command is declared; 20 bytes is the segment limit only.

services.name: Nordic legacy DFU
services.notes: Documentary surface only. A dedicated updater must own control notifications, the full command sequence, .dat/.bin bytes, receipts, CRC and recovery before any write is attempted. No generic initialization, partial command or bare framing is exposed. Update runs in the normal application, not a separately identified DfuTarg mode. Only matching official 1.16 images belong here.

set_playing.description: Set phone playback state shown by the watch: 01 playing, 00 paused.

characteristics.name: Artist
characteristics.notes: UTF-8; firmware caps display strings at 40 bytes and truncates longer values with an ellipsis.

characteristics.name: Navigation icon flag
characteristics.notes: UTF-8 icon name from protocol_details.navigation.icon_examples; do not send an unlisted icon and expect an image.

characteristics.name: Navigation narrative
characteristics.notes: UTF-8 instruction text supplied by the companion.

characteristics.name: Maneuver distance
characteristics.notes: Short UTF-8 display string such as 50 m; it is not a fixed numeric unit.

format.name: steps
format.notes: Current session count; not a historical database.

characteristics.name: Simple Weather data
characteristics.notes: Type/version byte pair then fixed message body: current v0=49 bytes, current v1=53 bytes, forecast v0=36 bytes. All multibyte numbers are LE. See protocol_details.simple_weather for strict lengths and sentinels.

services.name: InfiniTime Simple Weather Service
services.notes: Only this service/layout is in scope. The legacy 00040000 service is not accepted. Writes carry complete characteristic values; do not invent a 20-byte application fragmentation scheme. Negotiate ATT long writes/adequate MTU through the host.

characteristics.name: BLE FS transfer
characteristics.notes: Commands/responses are complete protocol packets, not fixed-size 20-byte notifications. Exact command layouts and status semantics are in protocol_details.ble_fs. Mutating commands are advanced and not bound to ordinary one-tap entities.

initialization.notes: Every file command has a response here; parse the complete response header before data.

services.name: BLE File Transfer
services.notes: Adafruit-derived BLE FS version 4, with InfiniTime signed LittleFS errors. File access can be disabled in settings. Read/list operations are the least-risk first capture; write/mkdir/delete/move are advanced and optional.
